The test image shows two bell peppers with large, dark, sunken lesions covering most of the fruit surface. Key features:
- Dark brown to black coloration
- Deeply sunken/collapsed tissue
- Concentric ring patterns (target-like)
- Wrinkled, shriveled affected areas

This pattern strongly suggests **Anthracnose** (dark sunken circular fruit lesions with concentric rings). Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference Anthracnose image confirms the pattern: sunken, circular lesions on fruit with dark centers. The test image matches this disease type, showing advanced anthracnose on bell peppers with the characteristic large dark sunken lesions and concentric ring patterns. The much larger/darker appearance in the test image is consistent with a more advanced infection stage.
